text: Gamma operators distribute a trojanized installer from https://downloads.example.com/setup.exe. Researchers sinkholed 10.0.0.5, an internal address that appears in logs and is not an indicator. The installer's SHA-256 is e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855 and it queries the C2 domain gamma-c2.example.com. Persistence is achieved via a scheduled task (T1053.005).
